summary: Seward angrily rejects Van Helsing's claim, but they visit the injured child at North Hospital under Dr. Vincent, dine at Jack Straw's Castle and at night enter the Westenra tomb at Kingstead. Van Helsing cuts open Lucy's lead coffin with a turnscrew and fret-saw and shows it empty. They watch the churchyard; a white figure appears and Van Helsing recovers an unharmed child. The next afternoon Lucy lies in her coffin, redder and more beautiful, with sharper teeth; Van Helsing explains she is Un-Dead and must be beheaded, mouthed with garlic and staked, but delays to fetch Arthur. He leaves a note for Seward with instructions, and spends the night sealing the tomb with garlic and a crucifix. Seward doubts again, then on 29 September Van Helsing persuades Arthur and Quincey to join him.

scenes.title: The accusation
scenes.summary: Seward slams the table; Van Helsing proposes to prove it and produces the tomb key.

scenes.title: North Hospital
scenes.summary: Dr. Vincent shows the throat punctures and suggests a rat, bat or escaped wolf; the child asks to go play with the bloofer lady.
scenes.key_quote: he said he wanted to play with the ‘bloofer lady.’

scenes.title: Dinner at Jack Straw's Castle
scenes.summary: They dine among noisy bicyclists, then walk through the dark with scattered lamps.

scenes.title: Opening the coffin
scenes.summary: They climb the wall; Van Helsing opens the falling-lock door, lights a candle, unscrews the coffin lid, saws the lead casing, and shows an empty coffin.

scenes.title: The vigil and the child
scenes.summary: Seward hides behind a yew; a white streak glides between yews, a dark mass moves; Van Helsing catches a tiny child. They leave it for a policeman on the Heath.

scenes.title: The sleeping Un-Dead
scenes.summary: After the noon funeral and sexton's lock-up, they find Lucy in her coffin, more radiant, lips red, canines sharp. Van Helsing explains the Un-Dead and tells of the cure but delays.

scenes.title: The note in the portmanteau
scenes.summary: Van Helsing leaves instructions in case he is killed: find the great Un-Dead and cut off his head and burn or stake his heart.
scenes.key_quote: cut off his head and burn his heart or drive a stake through it

scenes.title: Seward doubts again
scenes.summary: Next morning Seward is again sceptical and wonders if Van Helsing is mad.
scenes.key_quote: Is it possible that the Professor can have done it himself?

scenes.title: Persuading Arthur and Quincey
scenes.summary: Van Helsing asks them to enter the tomb and open the coffin; Arthur is furious but finally agrees to go and wait.
scenes.key_quote: But, I beseech you, do not go forth in anger with me.

creatures.name: Lucy Westenra, Un-Dead
creatures.description: A corpse unchanged for a week, rosier than in life, with sharpened teeth; travels at night as a white figure.
creatures.behaviour: Leaves her coffin at sundown and lures children, returns before dawn; sleeping face shows no malice because she was bitten in a trance.
creatures.quote: The lips were red, nay redder than before

creatures.name: The Count (mentioned)

vampire_lore.quote: for at sundown the Un-Dead can move

vampire_lore.rule: Lucy was bitten while in a trance.

vampire_lore.quote: in trance could he best come to take more blood

vampire_lore.detail: Van Helsing's plan; kill Un-Dead in sleep.

vampire_lore.rule: Master vampire strength of twenty men; can summon a wolf.

puzzles.name: The empty coffin
puzzles.setup: Seward doubts Van Helsing; the coffin lid is unscrewed and a lead liner cut open.
puzzles.obstacle: Cut through lead without damaging; avoid gas.
puzzles.book_solution: Turnscrew punctures lead, fret-saw cuts two feet and across, flap bent back.
puzzles.game_idea: A timed lockpicking-style puzzle: cut through coffin liner without wasting candle or alerting the sexton.
puzzles.quote: he sawed down a couple of feet along one side of the lead coffin

puzzles.name: Falling lock vs spring lock
puzzles.book_solution: Van Helsing checks lock type before closing the door.
puzzles.game_idea: Inspect the lock mechanism before entering or risk being trapped.
puzzles.quote: the lock was a falling, and not a spring, one.

puzzles.name: Hospital to churchyard timing
puzzles.obstacle: Must be in position before midnight.
puzzles.game_idea: Route-planning through dark Hampstead avoiding patrols.

puzzles.name: Disposing of the child
puzzles.setup: Rescued child; police station would demand statements.
puzzles.book_solution: Leave child on Heath path and watch until policeman finds it.
puzzles.game_idea: Stealth hand-off: drop the child within a patrol's route and slip away unseen.
puzzles.quote: we would then seek our way home as quickly as we could.

puzzles.name: The tomb door seal
puzzles.book_solution: Garlic and crucifix on the clamps.
puzzles.game_idea: Choose which wards to place on each exit of a tomb.
puzzles.quote: I shall fix some things she like not

combat.name: Vigil in Kingstead churchyard
combat.tactics: Split the watch on opposite sides of the churchyard; intercept the white figure that carries a child.
combat.outcome: Child saved, Lucy escapes unseen into her tomb.
combat.game_idea: Stealth encounter with two player-controlled hiders; success = child saved unharmed before dawn.
combat.quote: Suddenly, as I turned round, I thought I saw something like a white streak
